Class City

java.lang.Object
pt.ipp.isep.dei.domain.City
public class City extends Object
Represents a City with a central location and multiple house blocks.

A City has a name, a center coordinate, and a specified number of house blocks. House blocks can be assigned either automatically (random distribution) or manually (user-provided positions).

      public static City createCity(String name, int centerX, int centerY, int houseBlocksCount)
      Factory method to create and validate a new City.
      Parameters:
      name - non-null, non-empty city name
      centerX - X coordinate of the city center
      centerY - Y coordinate of the city center
      houseBlocksCount - desired number of house blocks (must be > 0)
      Returns:
      a new valid City instance
      Throws:
